request.prompt:
The attached image is a side-by-side pair from the SAME short video and the SAME camera crop. LEFT is BEFORE (context_0); RIGHT is AFTER (context_3). Panel labels give original recording seconds. Answer the tool-pickup question by comparing these two scenes.

Find which physical tool changes from resting on the table or being grasped in the LEFT panel to held away by the named hand in the RIGHT panel. Match its appearance and compare its old tabletop position. Check the other tools: a colored handled screwdriver that remains on the table is not the moved tool. A wrench has a flat metal body and an open/ring head; a screwdriver has a handle and slender shaft; pliers have two hinged handles. Printed pictures are not physical tools. Mere occlusion or a tool already in use in both panels is insufficient to establish a pickup. If the pair cannot resolve identity and pickup, report unknown/unclear.

Return JSON only, with brief visible facts, not reasoning:
{"tool":"screwdriver|wrench|pliers|unknown","shape":"handled_shaft|flat_wrench_body|hinged_handles|unclear","before_image_id":"context_0","before_state":"on_surface|grasping|already_held|unclear","after_image_id":"context_3","after_state":"held_away|on_surface|unclear","observation":"at most 30 words describing the moved object and any tools that remain"}

The only valid endpoint IDs are context_0 and context_3. You may use null for unresolved endpoints. Do not infer tool subtype, purpose, or whether the procedure was correct. No source label or reference answer is provided.

payload.question: Which tool did I pick up with my right hand in this clip?
